    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Modelo empírico multivariado com entrada de voltagens. Inclui threshold_voltage."""
    
    threshold_voltage = parameters[0]
    kp = parameters[1]
    xT = parameters[2]
    performance_voltage = parameters[3]
    LEVEL = parameters[4:]
    
    Veff_out = gate_voltage_abs - threshold_voltage
    if Veff_out <= 0.0:
        return np.zeros(len(gate_voltage_abs))
    
    subthreshold_coef = np.exp((-xT * Veff_out) / (performance_voltage + Veff_out))
    
    Vds_eff = drain_voltage_abs + gate_voltage_abs - threshold_voltage
